description: This is a SwiftUI source file defining the AboutSettings view for an macOS application, which displays app info, links, and updater controls.

classes.name: AboutLinkRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI view representing a link row with an icon, title, and URL that opens in the default browser when clicked.

classes.name: AboutMetaRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for displaying a label and value in a horizontal row, used for metadata display in the about section.

classes.name: AboutSettings_Previews
classes.description: A SwiftUI preview provider for the AboutSettings view with a disabled updater.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Constructs the SwiftUI view layout for the AboutSettings UI.

methods.name: versionString
methods.description: Returns the app's version string combining CFBundleShortVersionString and CFBundleVersion.

methods.name: buildTimestamp
methods.description: Returns a formatted build timestamp based on a stored ISO8601 string if available.

methods.name: gitCommit
methods.description: Retrieves the Git commit hash from the app bundle info dictionary.

methods.name: buildSuffix
methods.description: Constructs a suffix string including the git commit and debug indicator if applicable.
